name: Send an AI message without any credits
description: A brand-new user types a message to the AI assistant and taps send without having set up any AI credits. The app stops the message before it goes anywhere, shows a clear error, and nothing is charged or saved.
details: A brand-new user opens the drawer's AI tab, types a prompt into the composer, and taps send: with no AI credit key provisioned (fresh routstrStore), the send short-circuits BEFORE any network or message append at the deterministic no-api-key gate — the 'No API key configured' error toast renders (e2e-toast-no-api-key via the root probe), the composer screen stays alive, nothing is persisted, and the wallet remains untouched at ₿0
